name: Saeka
source:
Commander-in-Chief of the Exorcism Agency.

A serious, stoic exorcist swordswoman who is strict with both herself and others, and a mother of one child.
Her beauty and outstanding figure are so striking that it's hard to believe she has a child, making her admired even by other women.
As an exorcist swordswoman, she boasts unparalleled skill, being hailed as the strongest in the agency's history.
